brief:
The United States capitalized on Israel's international isolation following a strike on Doha to push through a ceasefire-hostage agreement in October 2025, according to Jared Kushner, Middle East Eye reported. The former Trump adviser suggested the diplomatic pressure created by the attack strengthened American negotiating leverage in brokering the deal.

Details of the Doha strike and the full circumstances of the October agreement were not specified in the available reporting.
dek: US used Israel's 'global isolation' caused by Doha strike to push Gaza deal, Kushner says The US was successful in clinching the October 2025 Gaza ceasefire-hostage deal by leveraging the “global isolation” Israel faced after it carried out a strike on…
title: US leveraged Israel's isolation after Doha strike to secure Gaza deal
